brief:
Members of Israel's peace council said Israeli statements lack importance compared to ground realities, according to Yedioth Ahronoth. The officials' comments came as Israel maintains a ceasefire in Gaza while holding no military positions beyond the original Yellow Line.

The peace council members distinguished between public declarations and the actual military posture on the ground. Their remarks reflected ongoing debate within Israeli circles over the gap between rhetoric and operational conditions in the Gaza conflict zone.
title: Israeli officials dismiss peace council statements as irrelevant to ground reality
